title: Using CUET (ICAR-UG) 2026 scorecards across central counseling and direct private university admissions
description: Learn how 2026 CUET (ICAR-UG) applicants separate official ICAR online counselling from direct CUET-score admissions at private universities.
summary: While NTA’s CUET (ICAR-UG) examination serves as the gateway for ICAR All-India Quota seats, many private and deemed universities also accept CUET scorecards through their own separate institutional application portals.

sections.heading: Central ICAR allotment versus university-level CUET admission
paragraphs: Applicants holding a 2026 CUET (ICAR-UG) scorecard encounter two distinct admission pathways: central ICAR online counselling for All-India Quota seats at participating universities, and direct institutional applications where universities such as [Lovely Professional University](/university/lovely-professional-university), [Chandigarh University](/university/chandigarh-university), [Suresh Gyan Vihar University](/university/suresh-gyan-vihar-university), [Tantia University](/university/tantia-university), [RKDF University, Bhopal](/university/rkdf-university-bhopal) and [Arunachal University of Studies](/university/arunachal-university-of-studies) consider CUET scores alongside their own entrance or merit criteria.
Submitting a CUET scorecard directly to a private university’s admission office is an institutional admission route, not an ICAR All-India Quota allotment.

sections.heading: Verify domain-subject combinations and CUET scholarship slabs
paragraphs: Before relying on a CUET score for admission or a tuition waiver, read [CUET and ICAR UG counselling: understand the admission route](/articles/cuet-icar-agriculture-admission-route) and confirm the required domain subjects (such as Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Mathematics/Agriculture) on the university’s official admission page.

faqs.question: Does applying for CUET (ICAR-UG) on the NTA website automatically enter me into a private university’s merit list?
faqs.answer: No. Whether applying through central ICAR counselling or directly to a private university that accepts CUET scores, you must complete the respective counselling or institutional registration separately.

faqs.question: Do some private universities offer fee waivers based on CUET percentiles?
faqs.answer: Yes, several private universities publish scholarship slabs linked to CUET scores, subject to programme applicability and renewal rules.
